units.source_text: 千重子坐在走廊上，望着枫树干上的紫花地丁，直到白蝶群飘去。

en.t: Chieko sat on the veranda, gazing at the violets on the maple trunk until the cluster of white butterflies drifted away.

units.source_text: 她真想对花儿悄悄说上一句：“今年也在这种地方开出了花，多美丽啊。”

en.t: She truly wanted to whisper a few words to the flowers: "You have bloomed in a place like this again this year. How beautiful."
